question.prompt: \(\triangle ABC\) is translated to obtain \(\triangle DEF\). Point \(A\) corresponds to \(D\), and point \(B\) corresponds to \(E\). If \(AD=5\text{ cm}\), what is the length of \(BE\) in cm?

solutions.explanation: The segments joining corresponding points after a translation are equal in length, so \(BE=AD=5\text{ cm}\).
solutions.title: Equal translation distances
